Continues a channel that [PauseChannel](PauseChannel) paused.
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic).
@gap A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
